data.query:
query Query($where: WorkOrderWhereInput, $orderBy: [WorkOrderOrderByInput!], $first: Int, $after: String) {
  workOrder(where: $where, orderBy: $orderBy, first: $first, after: $after) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        number
        priority
        originalQuantity
        quantity
        active
        integrated
        customerReference
        description
        externalId
        orderReference
        actualFinishAt
        actualStartAt
        earliestStartAt
        promiseAt
        scheduledFinishAt
        scheduledStartAt
        transactionAt
        customData
        integrationData
        workOrderStatusId
        workOrderTypeId
        customerId
        facilityId
        kanbanRackId
        maintenanceChecklistId
        outsourcePurchaseOrderId
        outsourceSalesOrderId
        outsourceTransferOrderId
        productId
        productStrategyId
        salesOrderLineReleaseId
        workOrderCategoryId
        workOrderGroupId
        workOrderPriorityId
        workOrderProcesses {
          edges {
            node {
              id
              order
              code
              originalQuantity
              quantity
              quantityToStart
              workOrderProcessDistributions {
                edges {
                  node {
                    id
                    number
                    balanceQuantity
                    producedQuantity
                    requiredQuantity
                    producedQuantity
                    scrappedQuantity
                    distributionGroup {
                      id
                      number
                      balanceQuantity
                      producedQuantity
                      requiredQuantity
                      scrappedQuantity
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

data.mutation:
mutation Mutation($payloadInventory: [InventoryUpdatePayloadInput!]!, $payload: [WorkOrderCreatePayloadInput!]!, $workOrderUpdatePayload: [WorkOrderUpdatePayloadInput!]!, $workOrderProcessUpdatePayload: [WorkOrderProcessUpdatePayloadInput!]!, $workOrderProcessDistributionUpdatePayload: [WorkOrderProcessDistributionUpdatePayloadInput!]!, $workOrderProcessDistributionGroupUpdatePayload: [WorkOrderProcessDistributionGroupUpdatePayloadInput!]!) {
  createWorkOrder(payload: $payload) {
    id
    number
    priority
    originalQuantity
    quantity
    active
    integrated
    customerReference
    description
    externalId
    orderReference
    actualFinishAt
    actualStartAt
    earliestStartAt
    promiseAt
    scheduledFinishAt
    scheduledStartAt
    transactionAt
    customData
    integrationData
    workOrderStatusId
    workOrderTypeId
    customerId
    facilityId
    kanbanRackId
    maintenanceChecklistId
    outsourcePurchaseOrderId
    outsourceSalesOrderId
    outsourceTransferOrderId
    productId
    productStrategyId
    salesOrderLineReleaseId
    workOrderCategoryId
    workOrderGroupId
    workOrderPriorityId
  }
  updateInventory(payload: $payloadInventory) {
    id
    number
  }
  updateOriginalWorkorder: updateWorkOrder(payload: $workOrderUpdatePayload) {
    id
  }
  updateOriginalWorkorderProcesses: updateWorkOrderProcess(payload: $workOrderProcessUpdatePayload) {
    id
  }
  updateOriginalWorkorderDistribution: updateWorkOrderProcessDistribution(payload: $workOrderProcessDistributionUpdatePayload) {
    id
  }
  updateOriginalWorkorderDistributionGroup: updateWorkOrderProcessDistributionGroup(payload: $workOrderProcessDistributionGroupUpdatePayload) {
    id
  }
}
